title: ADVERSARIAL VERIFY of Lane X (PE->XEX2 packer + round-trip)
summary: Independently reproduced Lane X's round-trip and Xenia load, plus three checks Lane X did not run (on-disk basefile compare, stock-DLL control launch, gdb backtrace at the abort). Tried to refute; could not. Every claimed field is internally consistent and independently parseable; the module fully loads in Xenia's real loader; the abort is a genuine harness limit proven identical for the stock DLL.

checks.check: round-trip byte-identity (fresh re-run, both compression modes)
checks.detail: roundtrip_test.sh into a clean dir -> FAIL=0. rt_recovered_none.pe and rt_recovered_basic.pe both md5 62985ed2e5ab6cad55e00b9390914837 == stock_basefile.pe. Container pack/unpack is lossless.

checks.check: packed BOOT container actually stores the RAW-thunk basefile on disk (idaxex -b hides this by re-rewriting)
checks.detail: Read boot_none.xex bytes [headerSize:headerSize+imageSize] directly: md5 535d9b817129482e2c203c1d79711e8e == raw_basefile.pe (the de-idaxex'd raw thunks). For compress=none the basefile is stored verbatim, so the container holds genuine packed {type=1|ordinal} thunks the loader expects.

checks.check: XEX2 header field self-consistency (independent non-idaxex parser)
checks.detail: magic 'XEX2'; moduleFlags 0x9 (TITLE|DLL); headerSize 0x1000; securityOffset 0x40 == 24 + 5*8; optCount 5; opt 0x00010201 IMAGE_BASE=0x84000000; opt 0x00010100 ENTRY=0x8401B590; FileFormatInfo enc=0, comp=0(none)/1(basic); SecInfo Size=0x1E4 == 0x184+4*0x18; HvImageInfo InfoSize=0x174; LoadAddress=0x84000000; ImageSize=0x40000; ImportTableCount=2; PageDescCount=4; AllowedMediaTypes=0xFFFFFFFF; RSA signature + all HV digests all-zero (confirmed 0x100 sig region == zeros).

checks.check: page descriptors classify [readonly, code, code, data], pageCount=1 each, 64KiB
idaxex independently parses the packed container
checks.detail: xex1tool -l/-i on boot_none.xex reads Base 84000000, Entry 8401B590, ImageSize 40000, Page 10000, Not Encrypted, Not Compressed, DLL Module, and enumerates BOTH import libs (xam.xex 44 imports, xboxkrnl.exe 55 imports) with correct ordinals. 'Invalid RSA/hash' warnings are the intentional zeroed-digest state and do not block parsing.

checks.check: Xenia real-loader: module fully LOADS before the abort (proven by gdb backtrace, not just log grep)
checks.detail: gdb backtrace shows abort at kernel_state.cc:448 inside KernelState::LoadUserModule -- the XThread::GetCurrentThread()->thread_state() call that sets up DllMain(DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH). Line 448 is reached ONLY after module->LoadFromFile() returned success (failure path returns nullptr + logs 'Failed to load user module') AND is_dll_module()==true AND entry_point()!=0. Therefore header-parse + section-map + SetupLibraryImports all completed, module flags parsed as DLL, entry point read. No 'Failed to load user module' and no 'unimplemented import' warnings in any log.

checks.check: CONTROL: the harness-limit abort is identical for the genuine stock DLL (refutes 'defect in our container')
checks.detail: Stock RB3Enhanced.dll copied to .xex and launched identically aborts at the EXACT same site (xthread.cc:117 GetCurrentThread, after Launching module + ResolvePath). Both packed modes and the stock all stop at the identical DllMain-on-host-thread wall. (Launching the stock as '.dll' was a red herring: Xenia treats .dll as a disc image and never launches -- extension-dependent path.)

attempted_refutations_that_FAILED: Suspected the Xenia smoke-test PASS condition ('Launching module' present AND 'SetupLibraryImports' absent) was backwards -- absence of import logging could mean load never reached imports. REBUTTED by gdb backtrace: load completed to the DllMain call at kernel_state.cc:448, past LoadFromFile success + is_dll + entry_point checks.
Suspected the container might be the reason for the abort. REBUTTED by the stock-as-.xex control aborting at the identical site.
Suspected idaxex -b of the boot image proving nothing (it re-rewrites thunks). REBUTTED by reading the on-disk basefile bytes directly == raw_basefile.
genuine_gaps_unchanged_from_handoff: Hardware boot on a physical RGH console (via RB3ELoader) is untested here -- no console in this environment. Xenia load is the strongest available proxy and it passes.

From-SOURCE path (feed a link.exe-produced PE with --entry + a synthesized --import-block) is NOT exercised by the round-trip, which copies the stock IMPORT_LIBRARIES block via --from-xex. The IMPORT_LIBRARIES generator from Lane L ordinals is still the last unbuilt packer piece. This is acknowledged in the Lane X handoff as remaining, not claimed proven.

No independent confirmation that a real RGH loader skips HV hash validation on a zeroed-signature XEX -- taken from spec ('unsigned boot acceptable') and consistent with idaxex parsing through the invalid hashes.
conclusion: Lane X's two headline claims -- (1) xex2pack produces a structurally-valid, loadable, unsigned XEX2-DLL, and (2) the round-trip recovers the input PE basefile byte-for-byte -- are CONFIRMED. All internal header consistency checks pass, idaxex and an independent parser agree, the container stores the correct raw basefile, and Xenia's production loader fully loads the module (flags=DLL, entry read, imports resolved) before hitting a DllMain-on-host-thread harness limit that is provably identical for the genuine stock DLL. Not refuted.
